automationNotes: Doc parity: verify steps use labelEquals with doc wording (labelMatch exact where UI matches; contains for labels that append "(required)"). Data privacy + Proceed optional when consent skipped. CMS Stacks: type **AUTO** (`value` / `DAL_CMS_STACK_SEARCH` / `DEFAULT_STACK`), poll for async results, then pick stack row whose **aria-label** matches filter when possible (else first valid row), then checkbox/listbox fallbacks. Launch + Personalize: first visible option. Lytics Account: `DAL_LYTICS_ACCOUNT_SEARCH`. Edit subsection: ⋮ → **`li[data-test-id=cs-org-edit-lytics-tag-modal-cta]`** (fallback `cs-ct-action-edit`) → hover → soft-check Edit → click. App Switcher → Data & Insights: if panel already open from prior step, do not toggle close; then `app-switcher-lytics` / product title. Row ⋯ uses `AUTO-DAL-` / `__dalLyticsDalTitle`. Headed: `npm run test:data-and-insights:lytics-integration:headed`.
